Lead Products

Top sales products

A cross-section of Ovation's best-selling PDAC-approved bracing — walking boots, ankle, wrist, thumb, knee, and spine support that helps dealers win the orthopedic category.

PDAC L4360/L4361
Patented

Gen 2® Walking Boot

The world's most advanced double-upright walking boot — ultra low profile, smooth natural gait, and incredibly light weight.

  • Pneumatic pump system
  • Sure-Grip resting surface
  • Shock-Pod: up to 50% less energy per heel strike
PDAC L1902
Patented

Nu-Form™ Ankle Brace

Blends the support of a stirrup with the comfort and compressive fit of a lace-up — semi-rigid frame, ultra-breathable fabric.

  • Fits all shoe categories
  • Multi-layer rotational protection
  • 3D spacer fabric releases heat & moisture
PDAC L3908

Versa-Fit™ Wrist Brace

Off-the-shelf wrist immobilization that reduces inventory space with auto-lock strap sizing.

  • Standard size fits virtually all patients
  • Auto-lock strap secures sizing
  • Cut low at the palmar crease for MP flexion
PDAC L3809

Versa-Fit™ Thumb Spica

Immobilizes the wrist and thumb with a neutral thumb position for opposition — ideal for gamekeeper's thumb and tendonitis.

  • Neutral thumb position
  • Auto-lock strap sizing
  • Reduces inventory space
PDAC L0631/L0637
Patented

Nu-Form™ Universal Back Brace

First back brace with a customizable/moldable anterior panel — unmatched breathability, extremely thin and low-profile under clothing.

  • Customizable/moldable anterior panel
  • Auto-adjusting pressure relief zone
  • Backed by a 5-year warranty
PDAC L1843/L1851

The Game Changer™ OA Knee Brace

Single upright OA brace that treats medial and lateral knee pain with easy push-button release for quick don and doffing.

  • Universal left/right sizing
  • Push-button release
  • For moderate-to-severe compartment OA
